title: Alpha One — event kyc.expired v1
description: V1 catalog event `kyc.expired` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = ANA-01 (no V1 email — D63: expiry is silent). Derived from: docs/13 §4.1 + D43 (docs/53): EXPIRED = 24 h session TTL only, fired by the session-TTL worker; APPROVED never expires in V1. Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.
